items.text: Die Discounter Lidl und Aldi haben den Preis für ein Stück Butter unter einen Euro gesenkt. Das liege an gesunkenen Einkaufspreisen. Der Bauernverband kritisiert die Senkung als "Ohrfeige für Milchbauern".

items.title: Kartenzahlung überholt erstmals Bargeld in Geschäften
items.text: Verbraucher in der Eurozone nutzen immer häufiger Kartenzahlungen. Trotzdem bleibt Bargeld beliebt - vor allem geringe Summen werden nach wie vor oft bar bezahlt.

items.title: Trump’s meddling in Huang scandal reignites voter angst over tech’s outsized political power
items.text: Nvidia’s decision to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang after pressure from Trump is intensifying bipartisan scrutiny of tech companies' ties to the administration.

items.title: Ukraine passes bill to legalize crypto and tax profits at 23%
items.text: Ukraine’s parliament passed a crypto regulation bill after three years of legislative work, with the new rules set to take effect in July 2027.

items.title: Fed’s preferred inflation gauge lands with a December rate increase already priced in
items.text: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 25, 2026

items.title: Ether, DeFi fall twice as hard as bitcoin as equities selloff resumes
items.text: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.2% since midnight UTC as the stock selloff resumes, with ether (ETH) and DeFi tokens falling about twice as far.

items.title: Italy’s UniCredit launches six-year bitcoin certificate with gains capped at 65%
items.text: UniCredit brings bitcoin investing to its roughly 8 million retail customers in Italy, offering them a six-year product that caps the redemption value but promises to return their capital.

items.title: Japan’s SBI, SMFG launch Solana venture for stablecoins, tokenization
items.text: SBI Solana Global plans to develop stablecoin payment infrastructure, explore AI agent micropayments and tokenize financial assets.

items.title: Euro-Schwäche: Was der "KI-Dollar" für Firmen und Sparer bedeutet
items.text: Der Euro ist zum Dollar auf den tiefsten Stand seit anderthalb Jahren gefallen. Hintergrund ist der KI-Boom. Welche Folgen hat das für Unternehmen, Verbraucher und Anleger? Von Angela Göpfert.

items.title: Futures sink further into the red as tech worries resurge
items.text: Huang defies calls for Nvidia succession planning, sending shares lower premarket

items.title: Viele offene Fragen bei Chipkonzern Nvidia
items.text: Jensen Huang steht wieder an der Spitze von Nvidia - und die Tech-Welt scheint wieder in Ordnung. Aber das kurzlebige Ausscheiden des Mitgründers hat Fragen aufgeworfen - und viele davon bleiben erst mal offen. Von Antje Sieb.

items.title: Hong Kong launches tokenized debt platform with 24-hour settlement
items.text: The HKMA’s new platform supports settlement in multiple currencies and handles debt issuance, interest payments and repayment at maturity.

items.title: Gold's haven status has lost its edge over bitcoin, and the Fed's to blame
items.text: Gold has lost the risk-adjusted advantage that made it this year's haven of choice over bitcoin. Both now offer negative one-year Sharpe ratios, leaving cash yields hard to beat.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs near $5B in record monthly outflows amid AI stock rout
items.text: US spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded $4.94 billion in November net outflows, exceeding the previous monthly record of $4.51 billion set in June.

items.title: Flixtrain-Tickets bald auch bei Deutscher Bahn buchbar
items.text: Zugreisende können demnächst auch Tickets für den Wettbewerber Flixtrain auf der Buchungsplattform der Deutschen Bahn buchen. Das vereinfacht den Ticketkauf erheblich - einige Hürden bleiben aber bestehen.

items.title: EU proposes $54.7 billion fund for AI, quantum startups alongside post-quantum security push
items.text: Brussels wants tech firms to grow at home. EU scale-ups raise about half the capital of San Francisco peers by year 10, an EIB study found.

items.title: Kerzen dürften deutlich teurer werden
items.text: Der Adventskranz gehört für viele zur Vorweihnachtszeit, doch die Kerzen dafür könnten in diesem Jahr ziemlich teuer werden. Hersteller rechnen mit Preissteigerungen von 30 bis 50 Prozent.

items.title: Deutsche Wirtschaft wächst im dritten Quartal nur um 0,1 Prozent
items.text: Das Wachstum der deutschen Wirtschaft ist zuletzt überraschend langsamer gewachsen als erwartet. Entgegen einer früheren Schätzung ist das BIP im dritten Quartal nur um 0,1 Prozent gestiegen.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs from lows as markets bounce from big early declines
items.text: The Nasdaq narrowed an early 4.5% plunge to just a modest loss, with Michael Burry announcing he's closed all tech shorts and gone long.

items.title: Solana developers move to stop validators finishing work on blocks that already lost
items.text: The fix would stop the computers that run Solana from wasting effort on transactions the network has already thrown out, freeing up power its recent speed upgrade didn't touch.

items.title: AI debt worries grow as Nvidia rebound masks Big Tech spending squeeze
items.text: Big Tech could find it increasingly tough to secure funding from debt markets critical to the AI build-out, as lenders become pickier over corporate bonds.

items.title: Just 10 accounts drove all of the XRP Ledger's trading growth last quarter
items.text: Data shows that the ten busiest accounts accounted for more than all of the exchange's quarterly growth, while trading by everyone else declined.

items.title: Crypto talent will return ‘when AI implodes,’ Arthur Hayes says
items.text: Maelstrom CIO Arthur Hayes expects the AI trade to face headwinds in the second half of 2027, with startup talent potentially returning to crypto afterward.

items.title: Deutsche Industrie: Wo es hakt und wo es rund läuft
items.text: Die Aussichten für die Wirtschaft haben sich zuletzt verbessert. Doch es gibt große Unterschiede: Während in manchen Branchen Firmen ums Überleben kämpfen, läuft das Geschäft anderswo prächtig. Ein Überblick von Axel John.

items.title: ‘Ready for any storm’: UAE minister optimistic on economy as IMF lifts forecast
items.text: The UAE is optimistic about achieving 7%-8% economic growth next year, banking on a "different" economic model.

items.title: U.S. jury convicts Huawei in a criminal trial over fraud and trade secrets
items.text: Huawei was found guilty of bank fraud, money laundering and trade secret theft conspiracy in a U.S. trial.

items.title: Jim Cramer says Tuesday's market pullback is an encouraging sign. Here's why
items.text: Jim Cramer said Tuesday's market action following Monday's massive rally is an encouraging sign that stocks are on the path to a more sustainable recovery.

items.title: Dell earnings beat on AI strength, company authorizes $25 billion buyback
items.text: The company's overall sales more than doubled on an annual basis during the third quarter, driven by AI server demand.

items.title: AI debt markets shudder as Nvidia's top 'banker' returns
items.text: Fears about some companies' AI debt ramped higher Tuesday, a day after Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO.

items.title: How Meta is using Instagram to get an ad boost from its Muse personal AI agent
items.text: Meta doesn't serve ads in its Muse personal agent, but the tool is already boosting the company's ad business, a senior executive told CNBC.

items.title: Verbraucherschützer haben die smarte Brille im Blick
items.text: Verbraucherschützer gehen juristisch gegen KI-Brillen von Meta und Ray-Ban vor. Der Vorwurf: Mit smarten Brillen lassen sich Fotos und Videos aufnehmen, ohne dass andere Menschen das bemerken. Auch Nutzern könnten Bußgelder drohen. Von Jens Eberl.

items.title: Consumer confidence shoots up after Democrats' midterm victories — though inflation worries persist
items.text: The Conference Board survey released Tuesday showed improvement across the board, with the headline confidence index jumping to 103.3.

items.title: Why France is at risk of recession — and what could keep it out of one
items.text: Bank of France Governor Emmanuel Moulin told CNBC he still expects growth, pointing to resilience in sectors including defense, aerospace and electricity.
